Waiting lists will be prepared and displayed by the admission committee as per merit and be notified as per requirement. Department Allotment: Departments will be allotted on the basis of individual merit position in the admission test at the end of admission against total vacancies. Brief History of BAUST BAUST is a private university sponsored by Bangladesh Army Welfare Trust. Bangladesh Army established BAUST on 15 Feb 2015 at Saidpur Cantonment and it was inaugurated by Hon’ble Minister of Cultural Affairs of Bangladesh on the same date. The intention to establish BAUST is to spread technical education to the remote places of the country. BAUST got approval to start its academic activities from Ministry of Education and UGC on 17 February 2015 and launched its academic session with four departments (CSE, EEE, ME, and A & S) on 15 Feb 2015 under 03 faculties. categories.name: Admission & Requirements
categories.summary: Undergraduate and Graduate admission eligibility: For Engineering programs (CSE, EEE, ME, IPE, CE), minimum total GPA 7.50-8.00 in SSC & HSC with Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. For BBA and English, minimum total GPA 6.00-6.50. Direct online application available at baust.edu.bd.

categories.name: Tuition Fees & Payments
categories.summary: Detailed 4-year undergraduate tuition fees: Engineering programs (CSE, EEE, ME, IPE, Civil) ~ BDT 7,50,000 - 8,20,000 across 8 semesters. BBA ~ BDT 4,50,000 - 5,20,000. BA in English ~ BDT 3,50,000 - 4,00,000. Payments can be made via Trust Bank, bKash, Nagad, TAP, or online payment gateway.

categories.name: Scholarships & Waivers
categories.summary: Waivers available: 100% tuition waiver for Freedom Fighters' children (Private University Act quota). Special discounts & waivers for children of Serving/Retired Bangladesh Army Personnel (Officers, JCOs, NCOs, ORs). Merit-based tuition waiver based on semester GPA (top percentile). Sibling waiver (10-20%) and need-based financial aid.

categories.name: Faculties & Departments
categories.summary: Offered programs: 1) B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), 2) B.Sc. in Electrical & Electronic Engineering (EEE), 3) B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering (ME), 4) B.Sc. in Industrial & Production Engineering (IPE), 5) B.Sc. in Civil Engineering (CE), 6) B.Sc. in Information & Communication Technology (ICT), 7) Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) & MBA, 8) BA (Hons) in English.

categories.name: Hostel & Accommodation
categories.summary: Separate secured on-campus and cantonment-adjacent residential halls for male and female students with 24/7 security, high-speed Wi-Fi, dining hall, indoor sports facilities, laundry, and generator backup. Male Hall: Abbas Uddin Ahmed Hall / BAUST Male Dormitory. Female Hall: Taramon Bibi Hall / BAUST Female Dormitory.

categories.name: Transport & Bus Routes
categories.summary: BAUST operates a fleet of university buses connecting Saidpur, Rangpur, Dinajpur, Nilphamari, and Parbatipur for day-scholar students and faculty members. Scheduled morning pick-up and afternoon drop-off routes.

categories.name: Campus Facilities & Labs
categories.summary: World-class campus facilities: Central Automated Library (thousands of hardcopy books + IEEE/e-journal access), Advanced Computer Labs, Heavy Machinery & Thermodynamics Labs, Robotics Lab, Modern Cafeteria with hygienic food, Medical Center with resident doctor and ambulance, large playground and basketball court.

categories.name: Contact & Location
categories.summary: Location: Saidpur Cantonment, Saidpur, Nilphamari-5310, Bangladesh. Admission Hotlines: 01769-675556, 01769-675557, 01769-675558. Email: admission@baust.edu.bd, info@baust.edu.bd. Office Hours: Sunday to Thursday (8:00 AM - 4:00 PM).
